description: Implementation of the CacCapabilitiesDatabase class, providing methods to retrieve CAC (Channel Access Control) capabilities, supported radios, and related information for the prplMesh project.

classes.name: CacCapabilitiesDatabase
classes.description: Class providing access to CAC capabilities and radio information within the beerocks namespace.

methods.name: get_country_code
methods.description: Returns the country code from the device configuration.

methods.name: get_cac_radios
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MAC addresses for 5G radios supporting CAC.

methods.name: is_cac_method_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific CAC method is supported on a given radio MAC.

methods.name: get_cac_completion_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration in seconds to complete a specific CAC method on a given radio MAC.

methods.name: get_cac_operating_classes
methods.description: Retrieves the operating classes supported for a given radio MAC and CAC method.
